summary: Finward Bancorp filed an 8-K to disclose that the FDIC and Indiana DFI terminated a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with its bank subsidiary, effective June 24, 2026. The MOU, entered in August 2024, was an informal administrative agreement. No financial terms, share prices, or timetables are involved. The filing is a routine regulatory update about the removal of supervisory restrictions. As an ordinary event disclosure without a transformative corporate action, it does not fall under a special-situation category.
